purpose: The re-run that the 2026-09-27 benchmark made a condition (#254 P7). It uses the same cases, fixtures and sample counts as runtime-bench-v1, under generic-editor-v2, which revises the instruction per that run's Findings. It runs on 9B only, the model that run recommended. It measures whether 9B answers the contract on identical permitted packets under the revised instruction, how fast, and at what memory cost. It is not #197's panel experiment, and it says nothing about curatorial quality beyond the declared checks.
models_note: qwen3.5-9b-v2 is the September 9B artifact (manifest 6488c96f...93ea7), runtime and generation settings, registered as a new pinned config because a model config pins its instruction and is immutable: qwen3.5-9b-v1 pins generic-editor-v1.

samples.budget_note: 16 calls at the 125 s reservation fit the 30 minute daily occupancy if the average call stays under about 112 s; September's 9B calls took 3 to 6 s.
samples.repeats_note: Temperature 0 and seed 195 are pinned, so the repeats of a case are expected to be one answer measured several times: four judgments, one per case, plus the smoke call. The summary's distinct_answers says how many there were.
